title: docs(examples): depend on all transitive internal dependencies
body:

**Summary**

This allows us to make a deep change in the helper, ui components or similar, but still try that out in an example in codesandbox without manually adding that dependency.

<!--
  Explain the **motivation** for making this change.
  What existing problem does the pull request solve?

**Result**

all local dependencies (including transitive) are explicitly depended upon for examples.

A visual way to try this out is running the react example and adding a chat. Works with this preview, but not with previous ones.
